# sonatypeiq_user_token_configuration (Resource)

Manage User Token configuration for IQ Server. Requires Sonatype IQ Server release 199 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create and manage User Token Configuration for Sonatype IQ Server
# Requires Sonatype IQ Server release 199 or later
resource "sonatypeiq_user_token_configuration" "user_token_config" {
  user_token_default_expiration_days = 90
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_token_default_expiration_days` (Number) Default expiration time for user tokens in days (1-365). Requires Sonatype IQ Server release 199 or later.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID for Terraform State
- `last_updated` (String) String representation of the date/time the resource was last changed

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# User Token Configuration can be imported.

# Example
terraform import sonatypeiq_user_token_configuration.config system-user-token-configuration
```
